title: What's New: Enhanced IT Audit Reporting (2026 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Approval Pages Enhancement and Help Experience
Analysis Views for Change Log and User Auditing
Users List and User Detail View Enhancements
Permission and Approval APIs for IT Access
General Business Central Resources for Partners

features.name: Permission Overview page
features.description: A new page that allows filtering and analyzing permissions across objects by type, ID, permission set scope, and app source. Users can see which security groups and users have each permission set, and pivot the data in analysis mode.

features.name: Approval User Overview page
features.description: A new page in 28.x that shows who is allowed to approve what and to which limits across different workflow types, accessible in one screen without navigating to each workflow individually.
caveats: Coming in 28.1 or 28.2, not in April release

features.name: Approval Entry Overview page
features.description: A new page in 28.x showing approval statuses across different workflow types, whether posted or unposted, with ability to perform analysis mode pivots.

features.name: Approval pages help improvements
features.description: All approval pages now appear in advanced tell me with teaching tips and descriptions, plus in-client help and correct documentation links when opening the help pane.

features.name: Analysis tabs on Change Log Entries
features.description: New analysis views added to change log entries showing data changes by table and field, and who changed what data when, enabling auditing of system changes and agent actions.
caveats: Requires change log to be enabled for tables and fields

features.name: Analysis tabs on Users list
features.description: New analysis views on the users list showing user status (enabled/disabled) and license type distribution, providing quick overview of user configuration.

features.name: Users list last login date and inactive days
features.description: New columns added to the users list showing last login date and computed inactive days, making it easy to identify inactive users and verify testing activity.

features.name: Users list fact box enhancements
features.description: New information in the fact box showing user setup details like allow posting from register time settings and direct navigation links to user settings, approval user setup, and user setup pages.

features.name: User Detail View improvements
features.description: Enhanced user detail view with support for analysis mode operations, new views for filtering by user status, and views for super active users and users inactive 7, 30, or 90 days.

features.name: Permission Sets API
features.description: Read-only API allowing querying all permission sets and navigating through access control subpage to see linked users and security groups.

features.name: Expanded Permission Sets API
features.description: API providing expanded permissions data including app name and table information from the expanded permissions table.

features.name: Security Groups API
features.description: API showing security group information with navigation through access control to see linked permission sets and security group members.

features.name: User Permission API
features.description: API showing users with navigation to user permission sets to view what permissions are assigned to each user.

features.name: Access Control API
features.description: Read-only API providing access control records that can be navigated to from other permission-related APIs.

features.name: Workflows API
features.description: API allowing navigation through all workflows and workflow steps, showing all steps for a specific workflow.

features.name: Workflow Steps API
features.description: API showing all the steps for a specific workflow, navigable from the workflows API.

features.name: Workflow Response Option API
features.description: API showing all step argument records including approver type, approver ID and related workflow step details.

features.name: Approval Entries API
features.description: API listing all approval entry records showing who approved what and when, available for both normal and posted approval entries.

features.name: Updated Security Guide
features.description: Comprehensive security guide updated with new objects, APIs, and specific guidance for different security scenarios including hardening practices learned from internal Microsoft work and conferences.
